source_locators: Processed XLS Loading metadata and 波形データ!E5

Statically decompressed Sheet1 VBA source, CommandButton1_Click
Vargas et al.2024 Sec4.2 PDFp2: equal chamber pressures and no applied normal-deviator stress
questions: All inspected shared H:K definitions subtract torque baseline H18 from raw torque, rotation, axial-load and pressure inputs; cached values at two fixed rows per workbook agree. What processing version produced this, why is a common baseline used across unlike units, and what is the intended channel-zeroing/correction chain? ON/OFF labels are present but the extracted VBA source contains no switch logic.

Which particle density applies to these specimens? Loading!B11 is cached empty in all nine workbooks; workbooks use minimum/maximum dry density1491/1757kg/m3 whereas the article states1490.5/1757.0. Confirm the intended index convention and whether these are campaign measurements or adopted reference values.
Within-release raw/workbook phase identities are now uniquely matched by exact content. Were any physical specimens or preparation batches reused across releases/campaigns?
Loading!B3 says target Dr60% for Dr50-0.10 and Dr50-0.15, while the summary says50%. Can these labels be confirmed as transcription errors without changing the measured-state record?
The VBA source derives cycle extrema and threshold brackets from frequency/sampling/pretrigger windows. How are partial final cycles and worksheet threshold interpolation handled?
All nine Loading sheets omit203–945 trailing raw samples while retaining exact prefixes. What rule selected these endpoints, and should the omitted tails be excluded for apparatus/control reasons?

The chapter reports equal inner/outer pressures and no applied deviator stresses in the isotropic tests. What normal-load feedback and axial displacement constraints were imposed during cyclic torsion?
